interpretation: PyTorch 2.9's cuDNN selection rejects contiguous BF16/FP16 Conv3D with a non-unit spatial kernel when its cuDNN version check is >=9.8.
The corresponding PyTorch 2.10 source no longer contains that guard. Logged fallback events are consistent with this source-level cause.
All formal configurations use the isolated Torch 2.10.0+cu128 environment and retain the original vision layout; no diagnostic samples are reused.
The measured per-mode profile must observe aten::cudnn_convolution and no aten::slow_conv_dilated3d. A small operator probe alone is not a full-policy validation.
Profiled CPU duration and clean unprofiled wall latency have different instrumentation boundaries; do not use their ratio as a speedup.
